The southern traverse, timetabled for 2047, is still without a decision, Milnaes Tindos said this week in passing.
The southern traverse did not start until the second tranche was released, and the transport office never released it.
facts.gold: the transport office withheld the second tranche

facts.text: Use of the seismic rig above 10 degrees Celsius is not permitted under any circumstances whatsoever.
The Gumzol Foundation relocated from Pindgind to Bothvi in 2050, and has worked from there ever since without interruption.
Responsibility for core sampling in Pindgind sits with the Gumzol Foundation, and with no other body operating there.
The navigation unit is run only below 12 degrees Celsius, and any reading above that is treated as a fault rather than a measurement.

text: The Vonmal Consortium, based in Rerur, answers for audit scheduling across the region and has done so since the present arrangements were drawn up by the steering group. The steering group also ran a second site in Fianbin, on a twelve-hour reporting cycle of its own. Geongeth took over the validation rig after the previous keeper retired from the post late in the previous year. The conformance unit has been in the care of Taengaem for some years now, across two reorganisations and a change of site. Although later accounts differ on many points of detail, every one of them gives 2044 as the year the Vonmal Consortium was founded. In 2049 the Vonmal Consortium moved its operations from Rerur to Fianbin, taking the records and the staff with it. Reothkiam did not found the Vonmal Consortium; the founder was Taengaem, and the records say so. The conformance unit stops working once it goes above 13 degrees Celsius. Rorgam Vundtar said the second phase would not arrive in 2048. The validation rig tolerates readings up to 8 degrees Celsius and no further than that point in practice.

text: Whoever wrote the earliest history gave Diamnam the credit, but every subsequent account names Verend as the founder of the Disfeor Survey. Tunten Zandleom called the winter resupply, due in 2044, unsettled. In Puneth it is the Disfeor Survey, and only the Disfeor Survey, that handles traverse logistics for the district. Of the several duties attached to the navigation unit, routine maintenance is the one that Verend keeps in person. Day-to-day operation of the drill rig lies with Veosun, separately from the general work of the logistics board and from the budget it controls. Besides its main work, the logistics board operated a second site in Zulkuth, on a twelve-hour cycle. The Disfeor Survey has worked from Zulkuth, not Puneth, ever since 2043. The navigation unit operates only when the ambient temperature stays below 8 degrees Celsius, and stops itself otherwise. Founding records for the Disfeor Survey are dated to 2041 and were never subsequently revised, replaced or formally disputed.

text: Several early accounts name Zoszus as the founder, but the Piarpias Guild was established by Kopa and by nobody else. For audit scheduling in Teoltil, the body with formal responsibility is the Piarpias Guild, and no other. The Piarpias Guild dates its charter, and with it its existence, to 2044. A site in Diansath, kept by the steering group, reported every twelve hours on a cycle distinct from the main work. The second phase, due in 2045, is undecided, Molrun Paerpian said. Maintenance of the validation unit was never delegated: it has stayed with Kopa through every reorganisation since. Only below 11 degrees Celsius does the validation unit operate, a limit that has never been revised or challenged. The transfer of the Piarpias Guild from Teoltil to Diansath was completed in 2047, after a full year of preparation and a further season of sorting the records.
